body:
## Summary

`Fd2dBlackScholesVanillaEngine::calculate()` does:

```cpp
const ext::shared_ptr<BasketPayoff> payoff =
    ext::dynamic_pointer_cast<BasketPayoff>(arguments_.payoff);
```

with no check that the cast succeeded. Its sibling `FdNdimBlackScholesVanillaEngine` performs the identical cast and immediately follows it with `QL_REQUIRE(payoff, "basket payoff expected");` — `Fd2dBlackScholesVanillaEngine` is missing that guard. A failed cast leaves `payoff` null, which is stored and later dereferenced unconditionally in `FdmLogBasketInnerValue::innerValue()` via `(*payoff_)(x)` — undefined behavior instead of a clean, actionable error.

`BasketOption`'s own constructor only accepts an `ext::shared_ptr<BasketPayoff>`, so this isn't reachable through normal `BasketOption` construction — but the engine's own `getArguments()`/`calculate()` interface is public API independent of any specific instrument wrapper (as the N-dim engine's existing guard already anticipates), and nothing stops a non-basket payoff from being set directly through it.

## Fix

Added the same `QL_REQUIRE(payoff, "basket payoff expected");` the N-dim sibling already has, right after the cast.

## Test

Added `testFd2dBlackScholesVanillaEngineRejectsNonBasketPayoff` to `test-suite/basketoption.cpp`: drives the engine directly through `getArguments()`/`calculate()` with a non-basket payoff after confirming normal `BasketOption` usage still works. Without the fix this hits an uncaught Boost `shared_ptr` null-dereference assertion (`px != 0`) rather than the library's own clean error; with the fix it throws a `QuantLib::Error` as expected. Full `BasketOptionTests` suite (33 cases) passes with no regressions.

🤖 Co-worked with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

review_comments.body: The new quote allocations wrap raw `new` expressions in shared pointers, contrary to the factory convention in `AGENTS.md:64–66`. Use `auto` with `ext::make_shared`; apply the same change to the process, exercise, and engine allocations at lines 3066–3081.

Good catch, fixed in ab3d85efc — switched the quote, process, exercise, and engine allocations to auto + ext::make_shared.

_🤖 Addressed by [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)_

title: Guard `Fd2dBlackScholesVanillaEngine` against a non-basket payoff
